description: Large-scale SketchMol comparison matrix. The scripts are wrappers around SketchSMILES plus the real SketchMol+MolScribe benchmark so training and sampling logic stays in the owning folders.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a4_seed7
runs.purpose: Best current OCR-free latent/fingerprint conditioned Transformer decoder with condition-fingerprint reranking.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a6_seed7
runs.purpose: Randomized-SMILES augmented version of Phase 5A-4 that tests whether multi-view SMILES training improves candidate coverage without train-pool retrieval.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a6_aug1_seed7
runs.purpose: Light randomized-SMILES augmentation to test whether small multi-view target diversity improves candidate coverage without broadening the training set too aggressively.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a6_aug2_seed7
runs.purpose: Medium-light randomized-SMILES augmentation candidate-coverage test.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a6_aug4_seed7
runs.purpose: Default randomized-SMILES augmentation candidate-coverage test.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a6_aug8_seed7
runs.purpose: Heavy randomized-SMILES augmentation test to check whether too much target-view diversity hurts exact canonical reconstruction.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a4_beam32_seed7
runs.purpose: Wider beam-search candidate coverage test for the Phase 5A-4 oracle-fingerprint Transformer.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a4_sample64_seed7
runs.purpose: Stochastic candidate generation with condition-fingerprint reranking to test whether deterministic beam search is missing valid target SMILES modes.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5a4_large_seed7
runs.purpose: Larger oracle-fingerprint Transformer to test whether 5A-4 is capacity-limited.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5c_seed7
runs.purpose: Image-conditioned SMILES decoder, closest to replacing SketchMol image-to-OCR with direct image-to-SMILES.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5d_seed7
runs.purpose: Image-conditioned SMILES decoder with a fingerprint auxiliary head and predicted-fingerprint beam reranking.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_phase5d_strong_seed7
runs.purpose: Stronger image-conditioned fingerprint-reranked decoder to test whether the fair image-input path is limited by image encoder/fingerprint supervision capacity.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_token_diffusion_seed7
runs.purpose: Route A: masked token diffusion that directly denoises molecular structure tokens into canonical SMILES without generating an image for OCR.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_token_diffusion_selfies_seed7
runs.purpose: Route A validity-focused variant that denoises SELFIES tokens and decodes back to SMILES to test whether the low valid rate is primarily a SMILES grammar problem.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_joint_diffusion_seed7
runs.purpose: Route B: shared diffusion backbone with SMILES token head plus learned sketch image head, evaluated by RDKit-render consistency instead of OCR.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_joint_latent_clip_seed7
runs.purpose: Route B shared-latent variant with CLIP-style image/token contrastive alignment to test whether explicit cross-modal latent binding improves image/SMILES consistency.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_joint_selfies_latent_clip_seed7
runs.purpose: Route B validity-focused shared-latent variant that combines SELFIES tokenization with CLIP-style image/token alignment to test whether joint alignment can preserve the SELFIES validity gain.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_joint_selfies_image_only_seed7
runs.purpose: Route B SELFIES ablation with the learned image head enabled but CLIP-style alignment disabled, isolating whether the contrastive term hurts token quality.

runs.name: sketchmol_compare_joint_selfies_light_aux_seed7
runs.purpose: Route B SELFIES ablation with lighter image and CLIP auxiliary losses, testing whether weak cross-modal pressure keeps alignment without sacrificing direct molecule quality.

runs.name: real_sketchmol_plus_ocr_seed7
runs.purpose: Original SketchMol diffusion image generation followed by MolScribe/OCR, used as the true SketchMol baseline.
